name: code-map
description: Understand a repository and keep its documentation true. code-map builds an interactive, layered code map as a local HTML file: architecture overview, module dependency map, algorithm pipeline with typed data flow, and the functions inside each stage, every node deep-linked to your editor and every edge citing its source line. wiki builds a code wiki an agent keeps current with the code: the README as front page, pages that name the source symbols they explain (checked by a lint), a run-and-debug page, rendered diagrams, executable setup commands, and a one-file viewer.

defaultPrompt: Run /code-map:code-map (Claude Code) or $code-map (Codex) in the repository you want mapped; add a path or --entry <symbol> to focus it.
Run /code-map:wiki (Claude Code) or $wiki (Codex) to build a code wiki for this repository, then /code-map:wiki update after a change.
